findings.message: The detector requires section 9.7's expected-to-stuck floor and a test proving it, but section 9.7 defines neither a formula nor a minimum. Driver uses the supplied stuck budget directly. Inventing a floor contradicts merged behavior; removing it contradicts section 9.7, which is outside the fence.
findings.paved_road: Authorize a governing plan correction by widening the fence to include section 9.7, then specify consistent deadline behavior and its named test obligation in both units.
